snippet.title: Yami Kids - Monster Taming Direct 2025 - Overworld Trailer
snippet.description:
Uncover the mystery on why an evil organization wants to find the Yami family, and put an end to the Yami lineage, in this dark themed monster tamer game.

Play as the Yami siblings and explore the Overworld, the land of the living, and the Underworld, the land of the dead. But beware of the encroaching shadows...

Game currently live on Kickstarter and coming soon on Steam!
